highlights.description: The module is `github.com/grokify/pgutil`, PostgreSQL only, and its root package needs no database driver

`provision` writes an idempotent `psql` script that provisions databases with owner and app roles, connection limits, timeouts and per-database `CONNECT` isolation, run as a managed server's non-superuser admin, and a query that verifies the server against the plan
`scram` makes SCRAM-SHA-256 verifiers, so a role's password never reaches the server in plain text

breaking.description: The module path is `github.com/grokify/pgutil`, formerly `github.com/grokify/godb`; the go-pg helpers in `github.com/grokify/godb/pgutil` are now in `github.com/grokify/pgutil/gopg`

added.description: `SQLState`, `IsUniqueViolation` and `IsInsufficientPrivilege`, reading any driver's SQLSTATE code without importing it
`scram.Verifier`, `scram.VerifierWithSalt` and `scram.IsVerifier` for SCRAM-SHA-256 password verifiers as PostgreSQL stores them

`provision.Plan` with `Script`, an idempotent `psql` script for databases, owner and app roles, limits, timeouts and `CONNECT` grants, with redaction of passwords for review, and `VerifySQL`, one row per difference from the plan
`Plan.Reachable` names databases, such as a managed server's `template1`, that every role may reach without `VerifySQL` reporting it

deprecated.description: The `gopg` package, built on go-pg, which is in maintenance mode; it is kept for existing callers

fixed.description: `gopg.PgConn.Addr`'s JSON tag, misspelled `josn`, so the address is read from JSON

tests.description: Unit tests for the helpers, verifiers and provisioning, and an opt-in integration test that provisions a throwaway PostgreSQL server as a non-superuser admin, checking idempotence, isolation, an owner resetting its app role's password, and drift

infrastructure.description: CI, lint and CodeQL use the shared Go workflows, on the `main` branch

documentation.description: README, and product and technical requirements, plan and roadmap

highlights.description: Maintenance: `any` in place of `interface{}`, CI and lint, and go-pg v10.11.2

infrastructure.description: Dependabot for Go modules and GitHub Actions

highlights.description: PostgreSQL helpers on go-pg, moved from `github.com/grokify/mogo/database/pgutil`

added.description: `PgConn`: connection settings from JSON, encoded as a connection string or as go-pg options, and a client
`TagHistogramSQL`, `SelectTagHistogram` and `SelectTagHistogramResults`: counts of each tag in an array column
`SelectArrayAny`: rows whose array column contains a value
